cardEffects: [Main] Choose 1 of your level 4 or higher Digimon with [Shoutmon] in its name. Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with DP less than or equal to the chosen Digimon.

errata.afterText: [Security] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. You may add 1 Digimon card with the [Xros Heart] trait among them to your hand, and play 1 [Taiki Kudo] among them without paying its memory cost. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.

name: Burning Star Crusher
nameJapanese: バーニングスタークラッシャー

rulings.question: If [Taiki Kudo] is among the cards revealed by this card's [Security] effect, can it be played?

rulings.answer: Yes, you can play [Taiki Kudo] even if there isn't a Digimon card with the [Xros Heart] trait.
rulings.question: If there is no Digimon card with the [Xros Heart] trait among the three revealed cards, can I still play [Taiki Kudo] from among the revealed cards?

rulings.answer: No, if you perform any of this effect you must perform as much of it as possible, so if both a Digimon card with the [Xros Heart] trait and a [Taiki Kudo] are among the 3 cards revealed, you must perform both "add [...] to your hand" and "play 1 [Taiki Kudo]," or you must choose to perform neither.
rulings.question: This card's [Security] effect reveals 3 cards. If both a Digimon card with the [Xros Heart] trait and a [Taiki Kudo] are among the cards revealed, can I choose to only activate the effect that adds the Digimon to my hand and not play [Taiki Kudo], or the other way around?
